response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total_telescopes AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM telescopes), shares AS (SELECT tc.observstation, tc.telescope_count, CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / tt.total as share FROM telescope_counts tc CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_average AS (SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share as share_minus_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_minus_average FROM above_average ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC LIMIT 10
